# `state/entity/ProvenanceStore.js`

> **Source:** `engine/state/entity/ProvenanceStore.js`

state/entity/ProvenanceStore.js — every observation, inference, prediction, and commit carries provenance (spec §14, rule 4). Vocabulary follows W3C PROV (entities, activities, agents, generation, derivation). Provenance lets the engine distinguish directly-observed vs inferred vs model-predicted vs stale vs untrusted data — crucial for the prompt-injection boundary (spec §15): retrieved/tool/model content is recorded as untrusted observation, never as authority.

## Functions

### `makeProvenance(p = {})`

Build a provenance record for a subject (a fact, version, or transaction).

**Parameters:**

- `p` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `p.source` *(string)* — e.g. 'tool:file-reader'
- `[p.sourceEntity]` *(string)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[p.generatedBy]` *(string)* — activity id
- `[p.attributedTo]` *(string)* — agent id
- `[p.certainty]` *(number)* — 0..1 confidence
- `[p.kind]` *(string)* — one of CERTAINTY
- `[p.freshnessEpoch]` *(number)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[p.derivations]` *(string[])* — _No description in source JSDoc._

### `isUntrusted(prov)`

True if a provenance record came from an untrusted external source.
